pattern.description: The cursor clicks the third Impact dot on the new idea row: the dots fill, a dark 'Medium (click to reset the value)' tooltip appears beneath, and the formula column instantly recalculates from 0 to 1.
pattern.why_premium: A single click shows cause and effect across columns (rating to computed score) without any cut, demonstrating the live formula field in a fraction of a second.

build_hint.gsap: tl.set('.new-row .impact .dot:nth-child(-n+3)', {backgroundColor: '#4bce97'}).fromTo('.impact-tooltip', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.05}).set('.new-row .ive', {textContent: 1}, '<'); all on the click frame, no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Discrete state change at the click frame: dots filled, formula text set to 1, tooltip opacity interpolated 0->1 over 1-2 frames (linear); no spring.

notes: Instant UI state swap (f371->f381). The formula '0'->'1' is a value swap, not an animated counter; count_up used as the closest change_type. No SFX candidates.
